excluded_attempts.reason: Curated fixture omitted a Stocco reference the core requested. Original output preserved; fresh rerun used complete current reference directory. Exclusion is a fixture repair, not answer editing.

review.method: Read actual answers; assess each frozen criterion plus usefulness and attribution. No keyword-based scientific grading.
review.blinding: Evaluators were not given rubrics, previous answers, audit, suspected errors or parent conversation; reviewer was not blinded.
review.source_scope: Reference syntheses and core only; no independent revalidation of every original book.

comparative_evaluation.claim: Current-content acceptance only; no measured baseline gain, reference gain, pre/post improvement or general reliability rate.

limitations: One sample per case, same inherited model family and platform instructions; fresh task contexts do not imply statistical independence or training-data independence.
Most fixtures contained preselected relevant references, so reference retrieval/routing completeness is not comprehensively assessed.

No clean-install matrix, empirical model validation, or new clinical/hardware verification is established.
